notes:
Video Studio automatically writes and records narration for product demos, walkthroughs, documentaries, and explainers. Music Studio casts a speaking voice and creates a backing track. The offline speech model reads the script in that voice across scenes. Workbench mixes speech above the music, times the captions, and saves the finished video to Recent clips.

Open a saved video and choose Record voice-over to make a new version with the same picture. Workbench can reuse its saved script or recover spoken words from older clips locally. A replacement script or timed captions are optional.

Fixed Windows path handling for local speech recognition and supported the floating-point WAV files produced by Music Studio.
